title: Relational Conditioning Retest
purpose: Retest orientating and boundary-front mediation using _R correctly as relation-conditioning mode.
core_rule: _R must be evaluated as a relation-conditioning subscript, not as a removable residue variable.
hypothesis: Within tested models, relational-conditioning mode improves recovery of procedural admissibility organization.
forbidden_tests: treating R as a standalone operator
testing _R by removing a variable named residue
success_criteria: RT(Sigma_R) outperforms RT(Sigma_null) on basin survival.
RT(Sigma_R) outperforms RT(Sigma_null) on basin reformation.
RT(Sigma_R) outperforms RT(Sigma_null) on admissibility-class recovery.
RT(Sigma_R) outperforms RT(Sigma_null) on boundary-front mediation.
failure_criteria: RT(Sigma_R) approximately equals RT(Sigma_null) across the recovery metrics.
Whole-expression conditioned evaluation does not improve procedural admissibility organization.
allowed_claim_if_successful: Within tested models, relational-conditioning mode improves recovery of procedural admissibility organization.
